headline: Wheaton Precious Metals to Acquire 1.5% Royalty from Spanish Mountain Gold for US$55 Million
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals has entered into an agreement to purchase a 1.5% net smelter return royalty on the Spanish Mountain Gold project for US$55 million.

headline: Newmont Issues Default Notice Against Barrick Over Nevada Gold Mines Joint Venture
summary: Newmont Corporation has formally issued a default notice against Barrick Gold regarding their Nevada Gold Mines joint venture, citing operational concerns and alleged diversion of resources.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Enters US$300 Million Streaming Agreement with KGL Resources
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals has finalized a US$300 million silver and gold streaming agreement with KGL Resources to support the development of the Jervois Copper-Silver-Gold Project.
